title: Fields of the World — Global Data (beta)
description: Beta release of the Fields of the World (FTW) global field-boundary predictions: per-UTM-zone GeoParquet field polygons for 2024 and 2025, and 2.5 m field/boundary-probability Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs for 2017–2025, hosted on [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/ftw/global-data-beta). Predictions derive from the [TGE Labs Sentinel-2 quarterly cloudless mosaics](https://source.coop/tge-labs/sentinel-2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaics/). This catalog is under construction; vector and raster collections land incrementally.
